info.brief: Save and load config and user data persistently between a Defold project's sessions
info.description: Save and load config and user data persistently between a Defold project's sessions

elements.name: autosave
elements.brief: Set to true to autosave all loaded files that are changed on a timer
elements.description: Set to true to autosave all loaded files that are changed on a timer

elements.name: autosave_timer
elements.brief: Amount of seconds between autosaves if changes have been made
elements.description: Amount of seconds between autosaves if changes have been made

elements.name: timer
elements.brief: Current timer value, only increases if autosave is enabled
elements.description: Current timer value, only increases if autosave is enabled

elements.name: changed
elements.brief: Locally used but can be useful to have exposed
elements.description: Locally used but can be useful to have exposed

elements.name: verbose
elements.brief: If true then more information will be printed, such as autosaves
elements.description: If true then more information will be printed, such as autosaves

elements.name: block_reloading
elements.brief: If true then files already loaded will never be overwritten with a reload
elements.description: If true then files already loaded will never be overwritten with a reload

elements.name: appname
elements.brief: Determines part of the path for saving files to
elements.description: Determines part of the path for saving files to

elements.name: loaded
elements.brief: List of files currently loaded
elements.description: List of files currently loaded

elements.name: sysinfo
elements.brief: System information captured at module load
elements.description: System information captured at module load

elements.name: use_default_data
elements.brief: If true will attempt to load default data from the default_data table when loading an empty file
elements.description: If true will attempt to load default data from the default_data table when loading an empty file

elements.name: enable_encryption
elements.brief: If true then all data saved and loaded will be encrypted with AES - SLOWER
elements.description: If true then all data saved and loaded will be encrypted with AES - SLOWER

elements.name: encryption_key
elements.brief: Pick an encryption key to use if you're using encryption
elements.description: Pick an encryption key to use if you're using encryption

elements.name: enable_obfuscation
elements.brief: If true then all data saved and loaded will be XOR obfuscated - FASTER
elements.description: If true then all data saved and loaded will be XOR obfuscated - FASTER

elements.name: obfuscation_key
elements.brief: Pick an obfuscation key to use if you're using obfuscation; the longer the key the better
elements.description: Pick an obfuscation key to use if you're using obfuscation; the longer the key the better

elements.name: use_serialize
elements.brief: If true then data is serialized with sys.serialize rather than encoded as JSON
elements.description: If true then data is serialized with sys.serialize rather than encoded as JSON

elements.name: default_data
elements.brief: Default data to set files to if any cannot be loaded
elements.description: Default data to set files to if any cannot be loaded

elements.name: obfuscate
elements.brief: XOR the input against a key, cycling the key as needed. Defaults to obfuscation_key.
elements.description: XOR the input against a key, cycling the key as needed. Defaults to obfuscation_key.

elements.name: get_file_path
elements.brief: The save path a file resolves to, or nil when no file was given
elements.description: The save path a file resolves to, or nil when no file was given

elements.name: save_all
elements.brief: You can save all files at once. By default, it will only actually save files with changes, but you can force saving all files by setting the force flag to true.
elements.description: You can save all files at once. By default, it will only actually save files with changes, but you can force saving all files by setting the force flag to true.

parameters.name: force
parameters.doc: false only saves changed files and true saves all files

elements.name: key_exists
elements.brief: Whether a key is set on a loaded file. Returns nil when the file is loaded but the key is absent.
elements.description: Whether a key is set on a loaded file. Returns nil when the file is loaded but the key is absent.

elements.name: isset
elements.brief: Alias of key_exists
elements.description: Alias of key_exists

elements.name: reset_to_default
elements.brief: Reset a file to its default_data entry, or to empty when it has none
elements.description: Reset a file to its default_data entry, or to empty when it has none

elements.name: is_loaded
elements.brief: Whether a file is currently in the loaded list
elements.description: Whether a file is currently in the loaded list

elements.name: update
elements.brief: In your update, if you want autosave to be enabled, you will need to include
elements.description: In your update, if you want autosave to be enabled, you will need to include

elements.name: final
elements.brief: Save all loaded files; call from your script's final
elements.description: Save all loaded files; call from your script's final
